title: Red Allen's father played with Lee's father in New Orleans
summary: Willard cites Whitney Balliett that Red Allen's father and Lee's father worked together in New Orleans, which Lee had not known.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Your father had a band in New Orleans. I read in Whitney Balliett's book, 'Such Sweet Thunder' that Red Allen mentioned his father; he said that his father and your father worked together in New Orleans.
No, I never read that -- I wasn't aware
of that, but maybe that's why when I met Red Allen, he was so friendly with me. He knew something I didn't. But no, I didn't know that. I wasn't aware of that.
Yeah, he told Whitney Balliett they played -- his father and your father played music together in New Orleans.
Well, they probably did, because you know, my dad was quite a good musician, you know.
